headline: 深圳灣文化廣場開幕
context: 建築事務所MAD（創辦人馬岩松）完成深圳灣文化廣場，這座濱海設計博物館結合展覽館與公共綠地公園，佔地約5.1萬平方公尺，建物面積達18.8萬平方公尺。館體造型像是幾塊散落的巨石，安放在起伏的綠色屋頂上，坐落在深圳南山區後海——當地科技企業總部聚集的地帶。

sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: MAD / Ma Yansong 's Shenzhen Bay Culture Square exhibition hall and park project began in 2018, with the project completed in 2020. The 188,000 m² building sits on a site area of approximately 51,000 m² along the city's waterfront, at the heart of Houhai, Nanshan District, the headquarters hub of Shenzhen's Greater Bay Area . The masterplan for the site, which includes the Creative Design Hall, the Shenzhen Science and Technology Museum, and a vast public green space, was announced by MAD in 2020 and was expected to be completed in 2023 . After eight years, the project, led by Ma Yansong, Dang Qun, and Yosuke Hayano, is now complete and is intended to serve as a cultural facility for design and cultural exchange.
sources.title: MAD Completes Shenzhen Bay Culture Square, a Coastal Design Museum and Public Park in China

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Architecture studio MAD has unveiled Shenzhen Bay Culture Square in China, a design museum formed of stone-like volumes perched atop an undulating green roof. Situated in Houhai in Shenzhen's Nanshan District, MAD designed the museum to be a hub for design and culture as well as a coastal public space for city residents to enjoy. The post MAD scatters boulder-like galleries across green-roofed museum in Shenzhen appeared first on Dezeen .
sources.title: MAD scatters boulder-like galleries across green-roofed museum in Shenzhen

threads_text:
建築事務所MAD（創辦人馬岩松）完成深圳灣文化廣場，這座濱海設計博物館結合展覽館與公共綠地公園，佔地約5.1萬平方公尺，建物面積達18.8萬平方公尺。館體造型像是幾塊散落的巨石，安放在一片起伏的綠色屋頂上，坐落在深圳南山區的後海——當地科技企業總部聚集的地帶，也是設計與文化活動的匯集點。

本則整理自 ArchDaily 與 Dezeen 於 2026 年 8 月 5 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 建築事務所MAD，也就是馬岩松創辦的那家，完成了深圳灣文化廣場。這座濱海設計博物館結合展覽館和公共綠地公園，佔地大約5.1萬平方公尺，建築本體則有18.8萬平方公尺。整棟建築的造型，像是幾塊散落的巨石，安放在一片起伏的綠色屋頂上，坐落在深圳南山區的後海——當地科技企業總部聚集的地帶。
